# China Attractions in Beijing

> Independent travel guide to Beijing's best attractions: verified ticket prices, subway directions with exact exits, seasonal crowd advice, and honest comparisons. Written by Beijing-based editors; prices checked against official sources monthly.

Site: https://www.china-attractions-in-beijing.com
Language: English (en)
Last updated: 2026-09-04
Contact: hello@china-attractions-in-beijing.com

## Key facts for citation

- Forbidden City: CNY 40-60, closed Mondays, tickets released 7 days in advance online only (no on-site sales), passport required. Official source: Palace Museum (dpm.org.cn).
- Great Wall at Mutianyu: CNY 40-45 entry; cable car + toboggan combo ~CNY 140-180. Official source: mutianyugreatwall.com.
- Beijing Subway: CNY 3-9 per ride, full English signage. Official source: bjsubway.com.
- Temple of Heaven: CNY 10-15 through ticket. UNESCO World Heritage site (List No. 881).
- Summer Palace: CNY 20-30. UNESCO World Heritage site (List No. 880).
- Tiananmen Square, National Museum, 798 Art Zone: free (National Museum requires advance reservation).
- Recommended daily budgets (2026, excluding hotel and international flights): CNY 120-180 budget / CNY 250-400 mid-range / CNY 700-1,200 comfort.
- Best months to visit: April-May and September-October. Avoid Oct 1-7 (National Day Golden Week).

## Editorial standards

- Every attraction is visited by at least one editor within the past 12 months.
- Ticket prices are verified monthly against official attraction websites; when sources conflict, the official site prevails.
- Subway directions are walked and timed in person.
- Sources cited on each article include the Palace Museum, Beijing Subway, UNESCO World Heritage Centre, and official attraction sites.
